name: chat-composer
title: Composer
description: The person's message: the chips a host may attach, each removable; the host's context chip, one summary of what every message carries (on the board, "3 answers · 2 selected": the selected cards and the answers since the last Send, and no other chips), which opens a preview of exactly that text; the text and Send; and one line under it with the keys, why Send waits, or why the composer is shut (the Architect composer).

files.core: composer-core.ts (composerView, sendIntent, chipKey, withoutChip, ComposerContext, PREVIEW_LABEL, COMPOSER_KEYS; no DOM)

states: the preview open by hover, held open by click, Enter or Space
holding: what is attached waits for the turn to end

attributes.data-shut: the host's blocked reason applies: the text can't be typed in

methods.show(view): Send allowed, the line, the placeholder, shut or not (from composerView)
methods.setContext(context): the host's context { label, text } beside the chips, or null: one chip, its summary, opening a preview of text exactly as it goes; not removable, it goes with every message the host sends
methods.clear(): empties the words and the chips once the message went through
methods.text, chips, attached, focusText(): the words typed, the chips, whether a chip or the context is attached, focus into the text

events: chat-send (bubbles): detail { text, chips }; Enter or Send, with words while the conditions allow; with a host that holds what is attached (ChatHost.holds), also with no words and while the agent works when something is attached. The words stay until clear()
chat-chip-remove (bubbles): detail { chip }; the chip is taken off and focus goes back to the text
whenNotToUse: A note on a card (the note bubble).
accessibility: The text is labelled 'Message to the agent'. Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line. Each chip's remove button is named 'Remove Card 12: <title>' or 'Remove Note: <text>', 24px square. The context chip is a button named by its summary, with aria-expanded; open, it controls the preview, a focusable region named 'What the agent receives' (a long one scrolls by keyboard). Hover opens it and keeps it while the pointer is on the chip or the preview; click, Enter or Space hold it open or close it; Esc closes it, focus on the chip, and goes no further (the board's Esc does not run).
